sources.cite: Google Cloud documentation, Cloud Router: Troubleshoot BGP sessions
sources.note: Read through a summarizing fetch on 2026-11-17. Relevant text: for a failed session, 'Check that the settings on your on-premises BGP router and the settings on your Cloud Router are correct' and review the Cloud Router logs; an ASN conflict is fixed by changing the ASN on the on-premises device or the Cloud Router; routing is handled by the VLAN attachment or VPN tunnel. The 'Networks and tunnel routing' page (read 2026-11-18): HA VPN 'Requires dynamic (BGP) routing'; the Cloud Router 'Learned routes' page (read 2026-11-18): 'Dynamic routes are removed when a BGP session is considered down or has been terminated'. That a replacement HA VPN gateway has new external IPs, and the log and get-status wording, are authored (to verify).
